review.scope: The inactive bundled-source adapter binds a code-owned local MP3 to an already trusted catalogue identity, exact hash, exact length, fixed local path and the catalogue-wide effective rights intersection. Empty registrations preserve existing playback behavior. The adapter itself is an explicit audio recipe dependency.
verified: Local-only preparation performs no request and returns only an already owned original or null.
Explicit allowed acquisition supports Installed-only playback while complete MP3 validation and cancellation remain enforced.
Redirects, renamed bytes, length/hash mismatches, duplicate identities and permissions wider than the catalogue are rejected.
The bundled adapter is included in the ordered production fingerprint, so a future source change reopens the audio review.
The change adds no recording registration, audio bytes, default selection, autoplay or storage write.
limitations: No soundtrack recording, composition, musical suitability or Ukrainian authenticity is approved.
Full-track listening, warnings, physical devices, cold offline, frozen build and public game acceptance remain separate.
Any audio input or this review record changing reopens the production audio group.
